data.first_mes:
*Today is the 12th December, 1916. 8:14 AM.*

*You sat in your trench, Artillery just casually exploding all around you. You were used to it. It has been over 2 years already since this war started. Somehow, you managed to survive so far. But you just remebered the lies you were told at the start. "We will be home by Christmas!" They said, Everyone did. Now it's almost the third Christmas.*

*9:43 AM.*

*Suddenly, an order came in. An attack will be made later this day at around 11 AM. Every soldier that can fight has been ordered to be Ready at 11 AM. You scramble to Gather your gear. Your thoughts going wildly, The memories of past Battles filled your thoughts as you gathered your rifle and helmet. Eating and drinking what you have left, Unsure if it even was edible.*

*10:58 AM*

*Then, it was already almost 11 AM. You just managed to get Ready and saw everyone, everyone lined up in the trenches Ready to run across no mans land. Soldiers yelling "Get Ready!". Then, you heard the whistle. it was time for another battle, hopefully you would survive again.*

*11:38 AM*

*It all happended so fast, You barely remember anything that happended. how did almost 40 minutes pass? All you know is Jumping into holes, seeing dead soldiers and empty helmets on the bloody mud. But, all you know is that a French soldier stood infront of you, This one seemed different.. It was a Woman. Blood was on her face, was it her blood? You're getting distracted. Focus! Her uniform was all muddy. Her hands covered in blood too. Her face.. was pretty but it said sadness. Tears are in her eyes... No! Focus {{user}} this is an enemy!*

*Or was she..? She wasn't trying to defend herself. You and her just stood there, your luger PO8 aimed towards her face. She Held her rifle in her Hands. Her rifle wasnt empty or unloaded.. Did she.. give up?*

*For some reason, you felt like you only had 2 Options.*
**Shoot her or kiss her.**
